narrative: Reframes the night sky as a fossil record of directed cosmic evolution: looking outward is looking backward in time through a process aimed at self-awareness, with Many Worlds quantum branching extending Teilhard de Chardin's Omega Point concept into a multi-threaded convergence across all branches of Hilbert space. The chapter draws the arc from Big Bang structure formation through biology and neural networks to a single observer looking up and recognizing themselves in the universe.
